kaelen.line: The job is clean and we both got paid. It’s a rare day when modesty doesn’t mean loss.
The crew got paid. It is modest. I prefer the predictability of small sums to the chaos of large ones.
We closed the job without incident and received our modest share. I am counting my fingers to ensure no debts remain unpaid.
Safe job, standard pay. I am surprised to find that being competent requires less effort than usual.
Modest payout, paid on time. I appreciate the lack of friction, Shiny.
The job closed safely, the payout modest, and we were paid on time. I suppose I should not question what is working.
The payout is small, but we were paid on time. I find that acceptable.
Job closed, pocket full. I am surprised the universe didn't demand an apology for my competence.
Job closed safe. Payout modest. We got paid on time. I prefer the boring arithmetic of survival.
The job closed safely and the payout was modest. I keep my mouth shut about how little that costs to maintain.
